label: SBMS 1.6.1

verification.textComparison: Direct content comparison after normalizing CRLF/LF and trailing whitespace; no file hashes.

sampling.areaCondition: Both source/target axis ratios are > 1.0001 and <= 2.0.
sampling.areaBranch: Exact pixel-area coverage plus adaptive horizontal subpixel-chroma suppression.
sampling.fallbackBranch: Bilinear sampling, including enlargement, 1:1, reduction beyond 2x, and single-axis reductions.

limits: This is a reproduction of the released sampling formula, not a screenshot captured from the installed release.
The demo sums individual area-weighted texels; the release combines the same coverage through four hardware bilinear fetches.
WebGL manual interpolation and native D3D11 hardware sampling are not guaranteed to be bit-identical.
The demo repeats texture boundaries while the release clamps them. Compare interior regions sufficiently far from image edges.
Animated demo offsets translate the common source before both algorithms; a static zero-offset comparison directly matches the released pixel-center convention.
These comparisons do not measure the installed application's performance or the separate Stream only capture and encoder path.
